name: Next.js Full-Stack React Development
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
Meta Front-End Developer Professional Certificate (React foundation)

beginner.summary: For React developers and web developers moving to full-stack React. Covers Next.js projects and the App Router, pages and layouts, navigation, server and client components, styling, images and fonts, data fetching in server components, dynamic routes, loading UI and streaming, error files, forms with Server Actions, route handlers, databases with Prisma, caching and revalidation, metadata and SEO, authentication with Auth.js, request interception with proxy, testing and deployment.
prerequisites: Builds React components with props, state and hooks
outcomes: Build full-stack applications with the Next.js App Router
Fetch, mutate and cache data with server components and Server Actions
Add authentication, SEO and a database

days.topic: Next.js Overview and Project Setup
subtopics: Rendering on the server and the client
Project structure: app, public and configuration files
TypeScript and ESLint in a new project
Building and running a production server
days.lab_task: Create a Next.js project with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, explore the app folder, edit the home page with fast refresh, add an environment setting and run a production build locally.
days.deliverable: Starter project in a Git repository
checks: Page updates on save without losing state
Build completes and lists routes with their rendering type
Value appears on the page from the environment file
objectives: Create and run a Next.js project

days.topic: Pages, Layouts and App Router File Conventions
days.lab_task: Build a site with home, about, blog and dashboard sections, a root layout with header and footer, a nested dashboard layout and route groups for marketing and app pages.
checks: Shared header stays mounted across pages
Route groups change folders without changing URLs

days.topic: Linking and Navigating Between Pages
days.lab_task: Build navigation with active link styling, a search box that updates the URL, a redirect for an old URL and a button that navigates after an action.
checks: Page changes without a full reload
URL query updates and survives a refresh
Redirect to the new page with the right status
objectives: Navigate with Link and the router

days.topic: Server and Client Components in Next.js
subtopics: What can and cannot cross the boundary
Passing server data to client components
Third-party libraries that need the client
days.lab_task: Build a product page where data loads in a server component and only the add-to-basket button is a client component, then measure the JavaScript sent to the browser.
checks: Server component code absent from the client bundle
Use state in a client component
Basket button updates without a reload
Keep a secret on the server
API key never appears in browser files

days.topic: Styling with Tailwind CSS and CSS Modules
subtopics: Tailwind CSS setup and utility classes
days.lab_task: Style the site with Tailwind CSS, build a card with variants, make the layout responsive, add dark mode and style one legacy component with CSS Modules.
checks: Layout works at mobile and desktop widths
Class names scoped to the component

days.topic: Images, Fonts and Static Assets
subtopics: next/font for Google and local fonts
days.lab_task: Replace img tags with the Image component, configure remote images, load fonts with next/font and compare Lighthouse scores and layout shift before and after.
checks: Modern formats served at the right sizes

days.topic: Fetching Data in Server Components
subtopics: Static and dynamic rendering of data
days.lab_task: Build a blog list and post pages that fetch data in server components, load author and comments in parallel and show empty and error states.
checks: Page time close to the slowest request
Message shown when there are no posts
Post content present in the HTML

days.topic: Dynamic Routes and generateStaticParams
days.lab_task: Build post and category pages with dynamic segments, prebuild popular posts with generateStaticParams, return 404 for missing posts and add a docs section with a catch-all route.
checks: Popular posts prerendered at build time
Nested docs paths render the right page

days.topic: Loading UI, Streaming and Suspense
days.lab_task: Add loading skeletons to the blog, stream a slow recommendations section behind a Suspense boundary and compare time to first content with and without streaming.
checks: Main content shows before recommendations finish
First content time improves with streaming

days.topic: Error Handling with error and not-found Files
subtopics: Errors in server and client components
days.lab_task: Add error boundaries per section, a custom not-found page, a global error page, retry buttons and server-side error logging, then trigger each case.
checks: Rest of the page keeps working
Reset button recovers when the error clears

days.topic: Forms and Mutations with Server Actions
subtopics: Server Actions and the use server directive
Validating input with Zod on the server
days.lab_task: Build create and edit post forms with Server Actions, server-side Zod validation, pending states and field errors, revalidate the list after saving and confirm the form works with JavaScript off.
checks: Field errors shown from the server
List shows the new post without a manual refresh

days.topic: Route Handlers for Building APIs
days.lab_task: Build a JSON API for posts with route handlers, add CORS for a mobile client, receive a webhook with signature checking and stream a CSV export.
days.deliverable: API endpoints with an HTTP collection
checks: Correct JSON and status codes for each method

days.topic: Connecting Next.js to a Database with Prisma
subtopics: Choosing a database for a Next.js app
A single Prisma client in development
days.lab_task: Store posts, authors and comments in PostgreSQL with Prisma, read them in server components, write them in Server Actions and seed realistic data.
checks: Comment saved and shown on the post
Only one Prisma client in development

days.topic: Caching and Revalidation Essentials
subtopics: On-demand revalidation with revalidatePath and revalidateTag
Seeing cache behaviour in build output and headers
days.lab_task: Make the blog list revalidate every minute, revalidate a post on edit, keep the dashboard dynamic and explain three caching surprises found while testing.
checks: Post page shows the change straight after saving
List refreshes after the time limit
objectives: Revalidate on time and on demand

days.topic: Metadata, SEO and Social Sharing Images
days.lab_task: Add metadata to every page, generate dynamic social images for posts, create a sitemap and robots file and validate structured data for articles.
checks: Social preview shows the generated image

days.topic: Authentication with Auth.js
days.lab_task: Add GitHub sign-in with Auth.js, store users with the Prisma adapter, protect the dashboard and post editor and show the signed-in user in the header.

days.topic: Request Interception with Proxy (formerly Middleware)
days.lab_task: Add proxy logic that redirects signed-out users from app routes, rewrites a beta path for a test group and sets a security header, and check which paths it runs on.
checks: Proxy runs only on the configured paths
Test users see the beta page at the same URL

days.topic: Testing Next.js Apps with Vitest and Playwright
subtopics: What to test in a Next.js app
Unit tests for utilities and components
Testing Server Actions and data functions
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for validation and components, test a Server Action against a test database and write Playwright tests for sign-in, creating a post and commenting.
checks: Action saves to the test database
Sign-in, post and comment flows pass

days.topic: Deploying Next.js to Vercel and with Docker
days.lab_task: Deploy the blog to Vercel with preview deployments, then build a standalone Docker image and run it behind NGINX with the same features.
days.deliverable: Two working deployments and a deployment guide
checks: Caching and images work in both deployments

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Blog Platform with Comments
days.lab_task: Build a blog platform with sign-in, a post editor using Server Actions, comments, categories, SEO metadata, caching, tests and a production deployment, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL and demo recording
checks: Sign-in, posting and commenting work end to end
Lighthouse scores of 90 or more for performance and SEO
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one product

intermediate.summary: For developers who build Next.js applications at work. Covers rendering strategies and partial prerendering, Cache Components and the use cache directive, advanced routing, optimistic mutations, server-only data access, authorisation and tenancy, internationalised routing, public APIs and webhooks, uploads, Stripe payments, URL state, real-time features, performance, instrumentation, security, UI component systems, testing, self-hosting and major version upgrades.
prerequisites: Has built a Next.js App Router application
Comfortable with server components and Server Actions
outcomes: Choose rendering and caching strategies with confidence
Build secure multi-user features with payments, uploads and real-time updates
Measure, test and harden Next.js applications
Self-host and upgrade Next.js in production

days.topic: Rendering Strategies: Static, Dynamic and Partial Prerendering
subtopics: Partial prerendering with a static shell
days.lab_task: Classify every route of a shop by rendering strategy, convert the product page to a static shell with streamed price and stock, and verify the result from build output and response timing.
checks: Each route has a strategy and reason
Shell served instantly with streamed dynamic parts

days.topic: Cache Components and the use cache Directive
subtopics: use cache on components and functions
days.lab_task: Cache product and category data with use cache, set lifetimes per data type, tag entries and invalidate them from admin edits, and prove personalised data is never cached.
checks: Repeated requests served from cache within the lifetime
Admin edit refreshes all pages that use the product
Basket never served from a shared cache
objectives: Keep personal data out of shared caches

days.topic: Advanced Routing: Route Groups, Parallel and Intercepting Routes
subtopics: Route groups with multiple root layouts
days.lab_task: Build a dashboard with parallel analytics and activity slots, a photo modal with intercepting routes that works on refresh, and separate root layouts for marketing and app areas.
checks: Modal opens on click and full page on refresh
Each slot loads and errors independently
Marketing and app areas use their own layouts

days.topic: Mutations at Scale: Optimistic UI, Revalidation and Error States
days.lab_task: Add optimistic likes and comments, undo for deletes, conflict detection for concurrent edits and consistent typed error results from every action.
checks: Count updates instantly and reconciles with the server
Optimistic change rolls back with a message
Second editor warned about the conflict

days.topic: Server-Only Data Access Layers with Drizzle or Prisma
subtopics: A data access layer for server code
Data transfer objects for the UI
days.lab_task: Build a data access layer that checks permissions, returns safe DTOs, uses transactions for orders and fails the build if client code imports it.
checks: Build fails on the server-only import
Sensitive fields never reach the client

days.topic: Authorisation Patterns: Roles, Permissions and Multi-Tenant Access in Next.js
subtopics: Checks in layouts, pages, actions and handlers
Why layout checks alone are not enough
days.lab_task: Add organisations, roles and permissions to a SaaS app, enforce them in actions and handlers as well as pages, add audited impersonation and write permission tests.
checks: Action rejected even when the page is bypassed
Data limited to the current organisation
Impersonation recorded in the audit log
objectives: Enforce checks at every entry point

days.topic: Internationalised Routing with next-intl
subtopics: Messages in server and client components
days.lab_task: Translate the shop into English, Hindi and Arabic with locale prefixes, localised metadata and sitemaps, right-to-left layout and a language switcher that keeps the current page.
checks: Same page shown in the new language
Titles and descriptions localised per language

days.topic: Route Handlers as Public APIs: Versioning, Webhooks and Rate Limits
subtopics: Designing a public API on route handlers
API keys and tokens for partners
days.lab_task: Publish a versioned partner API with API keys, rate limits, OpenAPI docs and outgoing webhooks with retries and signatures.
checks: Partner receives a signed event with retries on failure
objectives: Protect APIs with keys and limits

days.topic: File Uploads and Media Storage
subtopics: Upload options: actions, handlers and direct uploads
days.lab_task: Add direct-to-storage uploads with pre-signed URLs, validate files, create thumbnails, serve public images through a CDN and protect private files with signed links.
checks: Upload goes straight to storage with progress shown

days.topic: Payments and Subscriptions with Stripe
subtopics: Testing with Stripe test mode and the CLI
days.lab_task: Add subscriptions with Stripe Checkout, sync status through webhooks, gate features by plan, open the customer portal and handle a failed renewal.
checks: Plan active in the app after checkout
Access changes according to the dunning rules

days.topic: Search, Filters and Pagination with URL State
subtopics: URL as the source of truth
Updating the URL from client components
days.lab_task: Build product search with full-text matching, faceted filters and cursor pagination held in the URL, debounce typing and make every result page shareable.
checks: Same results shown in a new browser
One server request after typing pauses

days.topic: Real-Time Features in Next.js
subtopics: Options: polling, server-sent events and WebSockets
days.lab_task: Add live order status with server-sent events, notifications through a hosted real-time service and a presence indicator, and test behaviour when the connection drops.
checks: Customer page updates without a refresh
Online users listed in real time

days.topic: Performance: Core Web Vitals, Bundles and Images in Next.js
subtopics: Core Web Vitals in Next.js apps
days.lab_task: Measure a slow page, cut client JavaScript by moving code to server components and dynamic imports, defer third-party scripts, enable the React Compiler and report field vitals.
days.deliverable: Performance report with before and after data
checks: Third-party scripts no longer block rendering
Web Vitals collected from real visits

days.topic: Instrumentation, Logging and OpenTelemetry in Next.js
subtopics: Tracing server components, actions and handlers
days.lab_task: Instrument the app with OpenTelemetry, trace a page render through the database and an external API, report server errors and build a dashboard with an alert.
checks: One trace shows rendering, database and API spans
Alert triggers on a raised error rate

days.topic: Security for Next.js: CSP, Server Action Safety and Data Tainting
subtopics: Input validation and authorisation in every action
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted issues: an action without authorisation, a leaked user object, a missing CSP and an open redirect, then add a nonce-based CSP and security scans to CI.
checks: Passing the user object to the client throws
Strict CSP active without breaking scripts

days.topic: UI Components with shadcn/ui and Radix
subtopics: Forms with React Hook Form and Zod
Server and client boundaries for UI kits
days.lab_task: Build an admin area with shadcn/ui forms, a data table with sorting and filters, dialogs and a command menu, themed to the brand and checked for accessibility.
checks: Dialogs and command menu usable by keyboard
Field errors shown from the Zod schema

days.topic: End-to-End and Visual Regression Testing for Next.js
days.lab_task: Build a Playwright suite with authenticated fixtures and seeded data, mock Stripe, add visual snapshots for key pages and run the suite against every preview deployment.
checks: Suite runs on each preview deployment
Snapshot fails on a layout change

days.topic: Self-Hosting Next.js: Standalone Output, Cache Handlers and CDNs
subtopics: Build IDs and skew between versions
days.lab_task: Run three Next.js instances behind a load balancer with a shared Redis cache handler, a CDN for static assets and zero-downtime deploys, and test revalidation across instances.
checks: All instances serve fresh content after revalidation
No failed requests during a rollout
Static assets come from the CDN cache

days.topic: Upgrading Next.js Major Versions with Codemods
subtopics: Async request APIs and other breaking changes
days.lab_task: Upgrade a sample app across one major version with codemods, fix the remaining breaking changes by hand, test it fully and roll it out behind a staged deployment.
checks: Codemods apply cleanly and changes reviewed
Build and tests pass on the new version

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: SaaS Dashboard with Billing
days.lab_task: Build a multi-organisation SaaS dashboard with roles, billing, uploads, real-time notifications, search, two languages, caching, security controls, tests and monitoring, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL, test reports and presentation
checks: Sign-up to paid plan to daily use works end to end
Performance, security and test reports meet targets
Rendering, caching and data choices explained
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one product

advanced.summary: For senior engineers and leads running large Next.js products. Covers architecture for large apps, rendering and caching internals, multi-tenant SaaS with custom domains, monorepos, multi-zones, edge and Node.js runtimes, performance engineering, threat modelling, scaling data access, headless CMS and commerce, AI features, background work, accessibility and localisation at scale, testing strategy, observability and SLOs, migrations from the Pages Router and other frameworks, hosting cost, platform choices and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years building production React and Next.js apps
outcomes: Engineer performance, caching and security at scale
Choose hosting, runtimes and migration paths with evidence

days.topic: Next.js Architecture for Large Applications
subtopics: Feature-based structure in the app folder
Server and client boundaries as architecture
days.lab_task: Restructure a large Next.js app into features with clear server and client boundaries, a domain layer and shared UI, enforce boundaries in lint and record the key decisions.
checks: Lint fails on a forbidden import

days.topic: Rendering and Caching Internals: RSC Payloads, Client Router Cache and Cache Lifetimes
subtopics: How the client router uses payloads
days.lab_task: Inspect RSC payloads during navigation, trace a request through every cache layer, find why a page serves stale data and design cache lifetimes for a news product.
days.deliverable: Caching analysis and design for a news product
checks: Payload contents explained for one navigation
Root cause of the stale page identified and fixed
Each content type has a lifetime and invalidation rule

days.topic: Multi-Tenant SaaS on Next.js: Custom Domains and Tenant Isolation
subtopics: Subdomains and custom domains per tenant
days.lab_task: Make a SaaS app serve tenants on subdomains and custom domains, resolve tenants in proxy, isolate data with row-level security, keep caches tenant-scoped and test isolation.
checks: Tenant site served on its own domain with HTTPS
No cross-tenant data in any page or API
Cached pages never shown to another tenant

days.topic: Monorepos with Turborepo for Next.js Teams
subtopics: Shared UI, configuration and data packages
days.lab_task: Build a monorepo with two Next.js apps and shared UI, data and configuration packages, enable remote caching and deploy only affected apps.
days.deliverable: Monorepo with CI and deployment rules
checks: Both apps use the shared UI package

days.topic: Multi-Zones and Micro-Frontends with Next.js
subtopics: Multi-zones for separate apps under one domain
days.lab_task: Split marketing, shop and account into three zones under one domain with shared navigation and sign-in, deploy one zone independently and measure the cost.
checks: Users move between zones under one domain
Shop updated without redeploying other zones
Extra page weight and latency recorded

days.topic: Edge and Node.js Runtimes: Choosing Where Code Runs
subtopics: What runs at the edge in Next.js
Edge limits on APIs and packages
days.lab_task: Run the same route on the Node.js and edge runtimes with data in one region, measure latency from three regions, move data or compute and recommend a runtime per route.
checks: Latency compared across runtimes and regions
Unsupported API identified and worked around
Each route has a runtime and reason

days.topic: Advanced Performance Engineering for Next.js
subtopics: Server rendering cost and time to first byte
Hydration and Interaction to Next Paint
Partial hydration through smaller client components
days.lab_task: Set budgets for a slow product, cut server render time and client hydration cost, load test the server, enforce budgets in CI and confirm gains in field data.
checks: Time to first byte lower under load
Interaction to Next Paint improves in field data
CI fails when a budget is exceeded

days.topic: Threat Modelling Next.js Applications
subtopics: Trust boundaries in server and client code
Server Actions and route handler attack surface
Server-side request forgery from server components
Cache poisoning and data leaks between users
Supply chain and build pipeline risks
days.lab_task: Threat model a SaaS app built on Next.js, test for SSRF, cache poisoning and action abuse, fix the findings and set up a recurring security review.
checks: Threats mapped to every trust boundary
One user's data never served to another

days.topic: Scaling Data Access: Pooling, Caching Layers and Read Replicas
subtopics: Avoiding N+1 queries in server components
days.lab_task: Load test a data-heavy page, fix connection exhaustion with a pooler, route reads to a replica while keeping read-after-write consistency and batch nested queries.
checks: No connection errors at the target load
Reads go to the replica except after the user's own writes
Query count drops for the nested page

days.topic: Headless CMS and Commerce Architecture with Next.js
days.lab_task: Build a content and commerce site with a headless CMS and Shopify, add draft preview for editors, revalidate pages from CMS webhooks and personalise a banner without disabling caching.
checks: Editors see unpublished changes in draft mode
Page updates from the webhook within seconds
Banner personalised while the page stays cached

days.topic: AI Features with the Vercel AI SDK
subtopics: The AI SDK core and UI packages
days.lab_task: Add a support assistant that streams answers, calls tools to look up orders, grounds answers in help articles with pgvector and enforces per-user limits.
days.deliverable: AI assistant feature with evaluation results
checks: Responses stream into the chat UI
Assistant returns the user's real order status

days.topic: Background Work Outside the Request: after, Queues and Workflows
subtopics: Work that should not block responses
days.lab_task: Move analytics logging into after, send order emails through a queue with retries and build a durable onboarding workflow with waits and steps.
checks: Response time unchanged with logging added
Failed email retried and sent once
Onboarding steps run across days with waits

days.topic: Accessibility and Internationalisation at Scale
subtopics: Content in many languages and regions
days.lab_task: Audit a multi-language Next.js product for accessibility, fix focus and announcement issues, connect a translation pipeline and add automated checks for both in CI.
checks: No serious axe issues on key pages
New strings reach translators and return automatically
CI fails on missing translations or accessibility errors

days.topic: Testing Strategy for Large Next.js Codebases
days.lab_task: Assess a large Next.js test suite, rebalance it by risk, add contract tests and synthetic checks in production, and cut CI time with test impact analysis.
checks: API change breaks the contract test
Synthetic check alerts on a broken flow

days.topic: Observability and SLOs for Next.js in Production
subtopics: What to measure for Next.js products
SLIs for pages, actions and APIs
Tracing across front end, server and back ends
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for checkout and search, build dashboards from traces and RUM data, alert on error budget burn and run a review after a simulated incident.
days.deliverable: SLO definitions, dashboards and alert rules
checks: SLOs agreed for two user journeys
Alert fires during the simulated incident
Review produces actions from SLO data

days.topic: Migrating from the Pages Router and Other Frameworks
subtopics: Pages Router to App Router step by step
Running both routers side by side
Moving API routes to route handlers
Migrating from Create React App or Vite SPAs
Migrating from Gatsby or other frameworks
days.lab_task: Migrate three pages and two API routes of a Pages Router app to the App Router incrementally, protect SEO with redirects and plan the remaining migration.
days.deliverable: Partially migrated app and migration plan
checks: Old and new pages work together
Old URLs redirect with no ranking loss signals
Plan lists pages, risks and order

days.topic: Cost Engineering for Next.js Hosting
days.lab_task: Analyse a month of hosting usage, find the most expensive routes and features, cut cost with caching and image changes and set budget alerts.
checks: Estimated monthly cost reduced with no vitals regression
Budget alert fires in a test

days.topic: Platform Choices: Vercel, AWS, Cloudflare and Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Deploy the same app to two platforms, compare features, performance, operations effort and cost, and write a platform recommendation with an exit plan.
checks: Features, latency, effort and cost compared

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production Next.js Issues
subtopics: Triage from alerts and user reports
days.lab_task: Work through four production issues: stale cached content, a hydration error, slow rendering after a release and memory growth, fix each and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: Fresh content served after the fix
Cause identified with traces or bisect

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform on Next.js
days.lab_task: Design and build a multi-tenant SaaS platform with custom domains, tenant isolation, cache strategy, background workflows, AI assistant, SLOs, cost controls and a hosting decision, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, architecture document and defence
checks: No cross-tenant data in tests or caches
Load test meets the agreed SLOs
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
